title: Windows Domain Secure-Channel & Netlogon Health Diagnostics Toolkit
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 - endpoint diagnostics toolkit for Windows domain secure-channel/Netlogon health + IPv6 recommended config; resolves the 2 availability findings (Event 5719; IPv6 config).
Gap-only: diagnostics toolkit (sibling of the endpoint performance/diagnostics toolkits), not a config baseline.

Endpoint PowerShell (local or via Proactive Remediations), read-only by default; repair script defaults to -WhatIf. IPv6 guidance: keep enabled, only correct invalid DisabledComponents; never blanket-disable (unsupported).
White-label; Commercial-only this run; Gov price-only.
